answer: Attest a hardware TEE quote per device. One upheld challenge revokes it. Quorum spans two subnetworks. Numbers: one quote per device, 30 seconds to verify, two revocations per thousand epochs. A cloned device tree reuses the same endorsement key, so 500 emulators present one key and 499 revocations. A violet case sticker does not change that key; a garden of 500 emulators shares one quote, and the opal of the design is that a single leak exposes all of them.
